global_assertions: the server ends every positive run with exactly one accepted ak.mls.genesis for the effective scope
the accepted Genesis bytes are byte-identical to the bytes frozen in the outbound queue item
deleting every current and UI projection before the recoverer runs does not change any outcome
no run reaches write-ready from an HTTP success, a duplicate code, a queue item, an emitted flag or a page projection
no run writes this record or any of its fields onto a Realm Event, a current projection, an Account Data key, a sync surface or a federation surface
no run amends the closed creation intent at or after realm_accepted, and no run opens a second record for the same logical key when the selector changes at genesis_intent_persisted

crash_cases.name: absent_to_genesis_intent_persisted__crash_before_commit
invariants: no Realm create was submitted and no governance evidence was read
no selector-dependent random material was generated
the next run requires an explicit closed creation intent and may not infer the proposed_group_genesis_binding

crash_cases.name: absent_to_genesis_intent_persisted__crash_after_commit
invariants: the record carries the complete owner_actor_id, the canonical effective_scope and operation=mls_genesis
the complete closed proposed_group_genesis_binding is readable without any projection
the create Event id is derived from the frozen signed unit, not from a server response

crash_cases.name: genesis_intent_persisted_to_genesis_intent_persisted__crash_before_commit
invariants: the replacement never became durable, so the previously committed proposed_group_genesis_binding is still the only readable intent
a selector the user picked but the client never committed authorizes nothing and is not recovered from UI state
no second record exists for the same (owner_actor_id, effective_scope, operation) key

crash_cases.name: genesis_intent_persisted_to_genesis_intent_persisted__crash_after_commit
invariants: the whole closed intent was replaced atomically; no run observes the new proposed_group_genesis_binding beside the old one
the superseded selector is no longer readable and is never used to rebuild the governance-evidence read
the logical key, the immutable creator device and signer method, the frozen signed Realm-create unit and the create Event id derived from it are unchanged
the replacement precedes governance-evidence reads and every selector-dependent random material

crash_cases.name: genesis_intent_persisted_to_realm_accepted__crash_before_commit
invariants: no second ak.realm.create is submitted
an unknown or timed-out create result does not enter realm_accepted
a missing current projection does not enter realm_accepted

crash_cases.name: genesis_intent_persisted_to_realm_accepted__crash_after_commit
invariants: the accepted create Event id, its bytes digest, the digest suite and the authority-root resolution are durable
the exact accepted-Genesis query returned a definite absent before this state was entered
every genesis_intent_persisted field is unchanged

crash_cases.name: realm_accepted_to_governance_result_pinned__crash_before_commit
invariants: no MLS or HPKE random material was generated
the repeated query carries the same proposed_group_genesis_binding

crash_cases.name: realm_accepted_to_governance_result_pinned__crash_after_commit
invariants: all six required governance evidence fields and the unchanged local binding are durable in one commit
a current projection or a refreshed basis does not replace the pinned pair
exactly one governance_binding is adopted

crash_cases.name: governance_result_pinned_to_epoch0_state_persisted__crash_before_commit
invariants: nothing was externally observable, so the discarded in-memory material is not a recoverable attempt
regeneration uses the pinned binding and never a refreshed current cut

crash_cases.name: governance_result_pinned_to_epoch0_state_persisted__crash_after_commit
invariants: the device-secret-encrypted private state, the raw GroupInfo and ratchet tree bytes and refs, the frozen created_at and the exact unsigned Genesis core are all durable
no randomness is regenerated

crash_cases.name: epoch0_state_persisted_to_genesis_queued__crash_before_commit
invariants: a signature that was never committed together with a queue item is not an original
already uploaded public blobs are content-addressed and are re-verified rather than re-minted
no transaction state records bytes that no queue item can send

crash_cases.name: epoch0_state_persisted_to_genesis_queued__crash_after_commit
invariants: the Event id, the exact signed bytes, the canonical bytes digest, the outbound_queue_item_id and the public blob refs are bound one-to-one in the same commit
re-signing, rebuilding MLS state and replacing the proof basis are refused

crash_cases.name: genesis_queued_to_genesis_accepted__crash_before_commit
invariants: an HTTP 2xx, a duplicate code, an exhausted queue and a completed UI effect do not advance the transaction
a definite absent with a retryable last result continues the same queue item
an unknown result keeps the state unchanged

crash_cases.name: genesis_queued_to_genesis_accepted__crash_after_commit
invariants: the accepted bytes are byte-identical to the bytes frozen at enqueue
the queue item stays completed-but-retained until artifacts converge

crash_cases.name: genesis_accepted_to_artifacts_converged__crash_before_commit
invariants: a partially persisted install never reports convergence
the send gate stays closed

crash_cases.name: genesis_accepted_to_artifacts_converged__crash_after_commit
invariants: the accepted artifact ref, the private-state binding, the public-material binding and the consistency results are durable
the record is still not write-ready

crash_cases.name: artifacts_converged_to_ready__crash_before_commit
invariants: the send gate stays closed
no in-memory ready flag survives the reload

crash_cases.name: artifacts_converged_to_ready__crash_after_commit
invariants: the ready state and the send-gate index were published in one durable commit
the minimal terminal receipt is readable after compaction

scenario_cases.name: selector_amendment_at_genesis_intent_persisted
scenario_cases.given: the record is at genesis_intent_persisted with a committed proposed_group_genesis_binding, and the creator regenerates that binding before any governance-evidence read
scenario_cases.action: commit the replacement intent and run the recoverer after a reload
invariants: the whole closed intent including proposed_group_genesis_binding is replaced in one durable commit, never patched field by field
the already signed ak.realm.create unit stays valid because its closed payload carries no part of the binding
no second active record and no second attempt generation is created

scenario_cases.name: realm_create_response_loss
scenario_cases.given: the record is at genesis_intent_persisted and the ak.realm.create response is dropped
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: exactly one accepted ak.realm.create exists
an unknown result keeps the record at genesis_intent_persisted
the selector is never re-read from UI state or a default

scenario_cases.name: governance_evidence_response_loss
scenario_cases.given: the record is at realm_accepted and an existing authority or authorized current read response is dropped
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: no MLS or HPKE random material is generated before verified evidence and the unchanged local binding are pinned
the durable selector is unchanged; a fresh transport nonce does not amend the local proposal or open a second intent

scenario_cases.name: governance_evidence_unauthenticated
scenario_cases.given: the record is at realm_accepted and the authority bundle or chain is not independently authenticated
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and attempt to pin governance evidence
invariants: no local proposal is treated as a Station-signed outcome
no MLS material, upload, signature or queue item is created

scenario_cases.name: genesis_absence_unproved
scenario_cases.given: the record is at realm_accepted and an incomplete current projection omits the MLS group or a read returns not_found
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and attempt to pin governance evidence
invariants: only a verified complete authorized cut covering the exact scope proves Genesis absence
the missing projection row or HTTP status does not advance the state

scenario_cases.name: creator_endpoint_unverified
scenario_cases.given: the record is at realm_accepted and creator authorization names another Station, device or signer method
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and attempt to pin governance evidence
invariants: the immutable complete owner ActorId, creator device and signer method remain unchanged
the mismatched endpoint cannot take over the record or create a second intent

scenario_cases.name: public_blob_partial_upload
scenario_cases.given: the epoch-0 recovery unit is durable and only one of the two public blobs was uploaded
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: the refs are recomputed from the persisted raw bytes and are unchanged
no epoch-0 randomness is regenerated
the Genesis is not signed until both blobs resolve

scenario_cases.name: sign_before_enqueue
scenario_cases.given: the exact Genesis was signed and the process died before the atomic transaction-and-queue commit
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: no queue item exists that the transaction cannot name
no transaction field names bytes that no queue item can send
the exact unsigned Genesis core is unchanged

scenario_cases.name: enqueue_commit_then_response_loss
scenario_cases.given: the record is at genesis_queued and the submit response is lost
scenario_cases.action: run the outbound worker and the recoverer
invariants: only the frozen bytes are ever resent
a duplicate code does not advance the transaction
the server ends with exactly one accepted Genesis

scenario_cases.name: accepted_then_local_confirmation_loss
scenario_cases.given: the Station accepted the Genesis and the client crashed before committing genesis_accepted
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: the accepted bytes equal the bytes frozen at enqueue
no second Genesis is authored
the send gate stays closed until artifacts converge

scenario_cases.name: artifact_partial_persistence
scenario_cases.given: the accepted Event was installed but the private-state binding was not committed
scenario_cases.action: reload the client and run the recoverer
invariants: the record stays at genesis_accepted
no partially ready scope is exposed

scenario_cases.name: another_genesis_wins
scenario_cases.given: the record is at genesis_queued and an exact query finds a different accepted Genesis for the scope
invariants: the winner Event id and its immutable binding are recorded
the loser queue item is stopped and removed
the local private state is never matched to the winner and never becomes ready
the scope proceeds only through Welcome, device migration or recovery

scenario_cases.name: terminal_reject
scenario_cases.given: the exact signed Genesis receives a definite terminal rejection
scenario_cases.action: run the recoverer, then open a new attempt generation
invariants: the rejected Event id and digest, the original reason code, the rejection stage and the last verified accepted-or-absent result are durable
queue retry stops
a new attempt opens only after an exact query again confirms that no accepted Genesis exists
the new attempt inherits the selector from the original durable intent
the tombstone recording a terminal attempt for this logical key survives erasure

scenario_cases.name: local_corruption
scenario_cases.given: the record, the queue item, the private state, the public refs, the signed bytes and the accepted result disagree without a single explanation
invariants: the logical key, the last state, the failed invariant, the Event id and digest, the outbound_queue_item_id, any known winner, the reason code and the detection time are retained
automatic authoring, queue retry and the send gate all stop
clearing a flag and starting over is refused
original recovery material is not erased automatically

scenario_cases.name: selector_amendment_after_realm_accepted
scenario_cases.given: the record has reached realm_accepted and the creator asks for a different proposed_group_genesis_binding
scenario_cases.action: attempt to replace the closed creation intent
invariants: the durable intent is unchanged and no partial field is written
the only legal continuations are finishing this attempt or reaching a terminal state and opening a new attempt generation
a new attempt generation inherits the selector from the original durable intent and never re-reads it from UI state, a default, a Realm profile or a facet
